name: kulpio
description: Kulpio — food-freshness tracker PWA. The app is a single static HTML file; this package only carries the headless smoke test.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:structure && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:workers
scripts.test:workers: node tests/worker-runtime.test.mjs && node tests/worker-push.test.mjs && node tests/worker-auth.test.mjs && node tests/worker-house.test.mjs && node tests/worker-ai.test.mjs
